ITEM 1 | Whole oval fruit, about 10 cm across and 9 cm tall, with smooth yellow-green skin, a brownish blemish and dark spots near the top, and a small stem dimple. It sits alone at the upper left of the plate. | 250
ITEM 2 | Cluster of about six sliced pieces, mostly halves and wedges 3 to 4 cm long, bright red with a slightly glossy, moist surface and tiny pale seed specks. The pieces are heaped together at the upper right of the plate, with the cut faces up. | 90
ITEM 3 | Single small round fruit, about 7 cm across, with bright orange, matte, slightly pebbled peel and a small dark stem end with a green center. It sits by itself at the lower right of the plate. | 120
